2.name: Franz Roll and the Lost Rainbow Hot Pants of Atraxes the Apple Bottomed
2.overview: Rock quests for an ancient artifact in order to prove he is worthy of working with his modeling role model, Franz Roll. Paper and Scissors compete to be more supportive of Rock in the hopes that one of them will head his entourage when he's famous.

2.name: Paper and Pencil Tell a Joke
2.overview: Paper and Pencil tell a kind of funny joke at a party and chase the feeling of people finding them funny by telling it again and again.

2.name: Scissors' Orchestra
2.overview: Scissors hires an orchestra to follow him around and score his life, helping him attract a famous girlfriend.

2.name: Shoot
2.overview: The trio's old friend Shoot comes back to town, ready for more of his favorite activity: exhaustingly annoying competitions.

2.name: Rock's First Day of Work
2.overview: Rock starts his job as Franz Roll's assistant and learns just how demanding his role model truly is.

2.name: Paper Attends an Elite Institution
2.overview: Paper believes he's been accepted into a prestigious college only to learn that he's been placed into the third grade, which is harder than he expected.

2.name: The New Landlord
2.overview: When Scissors convinces Lou the Landlord to quit, The Astonishing Catalina takes over and ruins his life.

2.name: The Origami Robot
2.overview: When Scissors swallows a pinecone, Pencil uses a technological marvel – the origami robot – to enter his stomach.

2.name: Scissors Sees an Inspirational Sports Movie
2.overview: Scissors sees an inspirational movie about a scrappy kid who defies the odds to become a football star and tries to do the same thing.

2.name: The Altruistic-Off
2.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors must prove their superiority over the Rat Bros in an "altruistic-off" - a competition of doing good for society.

2.name: The Album
2.overview: Scissors has a bad date with Lolly the pop star and becomes the most hated man on Earth.

2.name: Paper Takes the Phones
2.overview: Paper takes Rock and Scissors' cellphones so the trio can connect in real life, but it turns out to be the worst day ever to be off-the-grid.

2.name: The Bedtime Story
2.overview: Rock can't sleep, so Paper and Scissors must tell him a bedtime story, but he's hard to please.

2.name: Scissors is a Good Boy
2.overview: Franz Roll mistakes Scissors for a dog and adopts him, growing close to him and making Rock jealous of their relationship.

2.name: Paper's Family Get-Together
2.overview: Paper dreads his annual family get-together because his family is more accomplished than he is, so he hatches a plan to skip it.

2.name: Moonami 12
2.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors try to maintain their tradition of seeing every Moonami film on opening day.

2.name: Spider Court
2.overview: The trio ends up before a spider judge and jury for attempting to squish a spider in their apartment.

2.name: Scissors, the Supervillain
2.overview: Scissors thinks he's finally discovered his "thing" when he joins forces with the sleep-themed villain Dreamscape.

2.name: Car Wash Nationals
2.overview: Rock is sick and can't lead the Robo Car Wash in the Car Wash Nationals dance competition, leaving it to Paper and Scissors.

3.name: Emotional Support Convertible
3.overview: Paper is frustrated when Scissors gets a car registered as an emotional support convertible and brings it with him everywhere.

3.name: The Baseball
3.overview: The trio's baseball lands in an air force base, and they must enlist to get it back.

3.name: Rock's Half Birthday
3.overview: Paper and Scissors struggle to make Rock's outlandish half-birthday wish that he can fly come true.

3.name: Cherry Picking
3.overview: Scissors stays home when Rock and Paper go cherry picking, but when they grow much closer to one another, he feels left out.

3.name: Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Paper, Scissors
3.overview: Paper and Pencil inadvertently create a horde of Rock clones and decide to look after them together.

3.name: The Wish
3.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors find a genie, but just as they're about to make their wish, his 1,000 year curse runs out, and he can no longer grant their wish.

3.name: The Train Problem
3.overview: Paper and Sandpaper are on a train that gets hijacked by the Algebra Villain, who will make them crash unless Paper solves an algebra problem.

3.name: Salmon Delivery for Ya
3.overview: Rock and Scissors think of the perfect prank call, but Rock bails to watch Franz Roll's pet Kitty.

3.name: Hardcore
3.overview: When Scissors makes "being hardcore" a mandatory apartment rule, Paper goes to absurd lengths to prove himself.

3.name: Scissors' New Therapist
3.overview: When Scissors' therapist leaves town, he's horrified to discover his new therapist is Logan, his bully.

3.name: The Henry Winkler Episode
3.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors crash into Hollywood actor Henry Winkler's house, and they all go on a wacky adventure together.

3.name: Paper Loves Potato
3.overview: While trying to woo Pencil, Paper mistakenly ends up in a relationship he doesn't want with Potato.

3.name: Sandpapers' Workout Program
3.overview: Sandpaper is disappointed the trio is playing videogames all day, so she signs them up for her personal workout program.

3.name: The Secret
3.overview: Rock is bad at keeping secrets, so when he learns one that will devastate Paper, he goes to great lengths to keep it from him.

3.name: Paper: Renowned Researcher
3.overview: Paper travels back to the Paleolithic Era to save his reputation as a researcher, only to make things much, much worse.

3.name: Meatball
3.overview: Lou turns his cat, Meatball, into a vampire to try and keep him alive forever.

3.name: Scissors' Perfect Match
3.overview: Scissors falls for a beautiful mermaid he met on a dating app, but his desperate need to prove she's real threatens to destroy their relationship.

3.name: The Apology Soirée
3.overview: While Paper and Scissors throw an apology party for everyone they've wronged, Rock accidentally shrinks himself and Franz Roll, and the two struggle to survive the chaos.

3.name: The Watching
3.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors have a great time birdwatching until they return home to find the birds have started watching them.

3.name: Nightmares
3.overview: The trio discovers they're trapped in a nightmare and must wake up before one of them wets the bed.

lastEpisodeToAir.overview: The trio discovers they're trapped in a nightmare and must wake up before one of them wets the bed.

overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors are best friends and roommates who compete over everything, but it’s (mostly) all love. They each bring something different to the friendship - Rock is the moral compass, Paper is the practical one, and Scissors is the right amount of chaos. Together, they get into the wildest adventures.
title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
